failing.summary: docs/reference/writing-style.md:88: The Escapes section enumerates the machine-enforced rules that have no line escape as links_resolve, stray_root_docs and the citation_* rules, and lists the five banned-token families that take '<!-- docs-lint: allow -->'. harness_leak — added to the Structure table at v0.7.1 and the eighth rule in .abcd/docs-lint.json — is in neither list, yet it does have a line escape and it is a different token: checkHarnessLeak (internal/core/lint/harnessleak.go:42) skips a line carrying 'abcd-lint:allow' or 'abcd-audit:allow' and does not honour '<!-- docs-lint: allow -->'. A reader following the page as written either applies the wrong token or concludes no escape exists. The page states its own criterion as listing 'the whole machine-enforced surface'.
failing.note: A reference-page omission, not a false claim: captured as iss-2609020833531987 and corrected after the tag.
